name: paper-chase
description: The paper chase, automated. Turn PDFs into citation-backed markdown wikis.

scripts.package:win: npm run build && tsx scripts/build-launcher.ts && pkg dist/launcher.cjs --targets node22-win-x64 --output dist/paper-chase.exe --config pkg.config.launcher.json
scripts.package:win:raw: npm run build && pkg dist/chase.mjs --targets node22-win-x64 --output dist/paper-chase-raw.exe --config pkg.config.json
scripts.package:win:bun: npm run build && tsx scripts/generate-bun-assets.ts && tsx scripts/build-exe-bun.ts && bun build dist/chase-bun.mjs --compile --outfile dist/paper-chase-bun.exe
